|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Echo Base Destroyed]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Echo Base Destroyed (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 21 July 2024<ref name="ht-63a0ee1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual23-Dark/large/echobasedestroyed.gif</code> as published 21 July 2024: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/63a0ee1a7d7c0170dd5d75d69fefd6d973cd8f47/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/echobasedestroyed.gif holotable commit 63a0ee1] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, if Main Power Generators on table, may place a card from hand under Reserve Deck to activate 1 Force; reshuffle Reserve Deck. Once per turn, if 1^ST Marker 'blown away,' may take a [Hoth] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Echo Base Destroyed (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 2 August 2024: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, if Main Power Generators on table, may place a card from hand under Reserve Deck to activate 1 Force; reshuffle Reserve Deck. Once per turn, if 1^ST Marker 'blown away,' may take a [Hoth] card into hand from Force Pile; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Echo Base Destroyed]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Echo Base Destroyed]] (published 21 July 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•Echo Base Destroyed”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Walker Barrage]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
